name: Example View Requests Process
summary: Template for a protocol extension that acts on its view beyond its pixels.
description: A repository-ready AfterNight extension package for the Lite host with no interface that asks things of the image it was started on: it draws shapes over it, turns its selection area on and reads back the rectangle a person draws, zooms in, commits a step of its history and undoes and redoes it. Each request is AfterNight's to refuse.
author: Example Author
